verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows general Dropbox API capabilities (Files API, OAuth, webhooks) and mentions 'sharing' as a DBX Platform feature in passing, but contains no evidence of API endpoints for creating/revoking shared links with configurable visibility, password protection, or expiry settings. The password-protect and 'customize sharing invitations and links' mentions are tied to the web UI/plan features (help.dropbox.com, plans page), not to programmable API calls.
